mf-01.label: mf-01 · the measured facets as the mesh
mf-01.note: front and back facet maps as measured (no hand edits), lifted onto per-row elliptical sections from the side views; one flat colour per facet

mf-02.label: mf-02 · back kept inside the front outline
mf-02.note: as mf-01, with the back map's corners kept inside each part's front outline and the dark core at 80 % (in mf-01 both showed round and through the front)

mf-03.label: mf-03 · dark core flattened to the middle
mf-03.note: as mf-02, with the dark core flattened to a thin card in the middle of each section (3 % deep): big facets cut straight across the section, so a round core showed through them

mf-04.label: mf-04 · front facets drawn by hand
mf-04.note: as mf-03, with the front facet map drawn by hand (140 facets over 229 named corners, read off the clean reference on a 10 px grid at 4 to 8x zoom) in place of the measured one; the back is still the measured map

mf-05.label: mf-05 · back stretched to the front outline
mf-05.note: as mf-04, with the back map mirrored and stretched row by row so each part spans the columns and rows it spans from the front (was: clamped inside it), so the front and back shells meet at her sides

mf-06.label: mf-06 · closed head with coloured facial geometry
mf-06.note: Head-only study continued by Codex from mf-05. The existing hand-traced front facets are retained. A matching rear shell and edge strips close the head; rear facet layout and dark hair colours are inferred. Eyes, brows, nose, mouth and ear marks are traced into flat-colour triangles. No texture, no rig.

mf-07.label: mf-07 · hand-traced facial marks
mf-07.note: Same closed head as mf-06. Only the facial marks change: explicit coloured polygons replace the automatic contours, including a thin mouth line. The rear is still inferred and the model has no rig.
